directionsTap: Taabo xarafka ugu horreeya ee erey, kadibna xarafkiisa ugu dambeeya. Erayada la helay waxaa lagu tiriyaa shabakadda oo laga tirtiraa liiska.
directionsAcrossDown: Erayadu waxay u socdaan dhinac ama hoos.
directionsDiagonal: Erayadu waxay u socdaan dhinac, hoos ama qalloocan.
directionsBackwards: Erayada qaar waxaa loo qoray gadaal.
directionsKeyboard: Kiiboodh: ku dhaqaaq furayaasha fallaadhaha, riix Enter ama Space xarafka ugu horreeya mar kalena xarafka ugu dambeeya. Escape wuxuu tirtiraa xarafka ugu horreeya.
startAt: Ka bilow {letter}, safka {row} tiirka {column}. Hadda dooro xarafka ugu dambeeya.
empty: Ku dar erayo si aad hal-xiraale u samayso.
unplaced: Erayadan kuma habboona shabakadda waana laga reebay:
editing: Ciyaartu way hakan tahay inta aad wax beddelayso.
